doctrine:
Scope: this worktree owns reduction of code, tests, gate work and API/binary surface through source-bound AST and control/data-flow analysis. Its plan contains only its own work. Master, GUI and audio campaigns remain in their originating worktrees. Removing their inherited rows here neither completes nor cancels them; Git and OvergoDB retain their history. Do not import another worktree's plan. The operator explicitly directed this correction after 9565ed5c.

Priority: analyze the complete gate cycle before choosing the next optimization. Rank avoidable execution, repeated analysis and recovery cost from retained attempts; distinguish actual execution from planned work, independent invalidators from overlapping reasons, and commit latency from completion of deferred obligations. Prove the cheapest sufficient simplification through existing AST, dependency and execution owners. Consolidate preparation, checks, admission and evidence reuse; delete displaced paths. Preflight and publication consume one recipe. Preserve independent oracles, exact input binding and durable recovery. Keep analysis and its selected bounded implementation in one integration boundary; do not pay a full gate merely to publish another analysis row. Reassess the remaining bottleneck after each measured change. Existing test-input, fixture and API work remains local; reconcile landed changes before repeating it.

Execution: codex-surface-lead owns this lane. Claim each integration boundary with role surface-area-reduction; keep commands and consoles in this worktree. Review existing committed implementations before writing alternatives. Port only reviewed relevant code, preserving caller migrations and local fixes; do not merge unrelated runtime, scheduling or acceptance policy. Dependencies name local producer steps, not source commits or foreign tasks. Continue by updating this plan when measured outcomes expose the next useful reduction; an empty dispatch is not completion of the broader objective.

Proof: use existing repoanalysis, codeprofile and codemanifest owners. Record changed source, build context, call/read/effect paths, independent invalidators and retained evidence. Sequence diagrams project those same facts; no separate graph authority. Missing or unresolved edges retain required coverage. Preserve independent numerical, cancellation, recovery and format oracles, fixture lifetimes and error paths. Compare complete caller migrations and net SLOC/AST, duplicate excess, exports, imports and link targets. A harness increase requires a measured total-cost benefit; renamed wrappers do not count as consolidation.

Acceptance: capability freeze enforced by structure. Each row retains its existing lower-bound checks. Bind concrete reduction and counterexample acceptance through validated plan -edit in the owning package before closure. Use plan -setverify when a separate local acceptance run is useful; do not repeat it merely to bind an already reviewed command. The publication gate still executes its mandatory acceptance against the frozen candidate; this scheduling change grants no evidence reuse or reduced acceptance. No zero-match, missing-fixture or skipped-case credit. UNAVAILABLE inputs are explicit obligations to find or construct with provenance. Cheap static checks precede expensive verification; exact prior evidence is reused only when every relevant input matches. Preserve required gates and commit through their existing owner. Do not weaken acceptance or use throughput alone to declare correctness failure. Publish measured results and outstanding obligations, then return to dispatch.

items.title: Consolidate the highest-cost equivalent implementation paths

steps.title: Share source-rewrite publication across eight analysis paths
steps.rationale: Prepared after AST and control/data-flow review: eight source-read, snapshot-identity, edit-bound and file-write paths share mechanics while keeping different matchers and import cleanup. The ignored prototype passes nine existing conformance and numerical tests, removes 181 production lines and 1374 AST nodes, and retains one file writer with no new public API. Remove two context-import aliases. Bind every existing conformance lower bound before dispatch closure and preserve errors, edit counts, file modes, stale-source rejection and unchanged cleanup. This is maintenance reduction; the measured manifest hotspot runs first.

items.title: Reduce duplicated command and API ownership

steps.title: Reduce duplicated command and API ownership
steps.rationale: Use AST call graphs and the generated manifest to identify commands or wrappers with identical execution owners and distinguish operator from internal consumers. Preserve documented flags, exit behavior, protocols and supported compatibility consumers. Prefer existing command owners and shared typed inputs; remove obsolete duplicate dispatchers and link targets with complete caller migration. Bind exact before/after executable/export counts and owner tests before closure; manifest freshness alone cannot accept removal. Avoid introducing a new command framework or changing HTTP/audio feature scope.

items.title: Resolve retained audio fixtures and retire duplicate skip controls

steps.title: Bind existing audio fixtures through their declared authority
steps.rationale: Retained from surface-test-inputs/do, not completed by moving source-policy tests. Only two current callers remain: TestSpeechAlignmentAcceptance and TestSpeakerDiarizationAcceptance. Both short-mode exclusions and StoreAcceptanceEnv currently suppress them; the latter still names a removed foreign row. Resolve fixture locations through existing artifact/data-root owners, bind effective inputs into evidence identity, then remove redundant opt-in controls. C:/Users/jeffm/overgo_audiocpp/tmp contains the annotation archive and speaker-reference assets:156 captures exist with declared sizes, but hashes and execution still need validation. Reuse originals without bulk copies or foreign code/store mutation. Candidate worktrees must resolve the same inputs without ignored tmp snapshots or unbound environment overrides. Find or construct every required missing asset. Bind actual owning-package numerical, corpus, command and relocation assertions before closure; TestSkipConstantReach is a retained lower bound only. All 156 retained capture files have now matched the committed SHA-256 and byte-count declarations (53,980,528 bytes); model/archive identities and acceptance execution remain outstanding.

items.title: Prove reduced surface and repeated verification cost

steps.title: Prove reduced surface and repeated verification cost
steps.rationale: Compare source-bound package selection and actual executed/reused/failed/unstarted work against9565ed5c using retained results. Explain each exclusion and remaining invalidator; do not sum overlapping phase times or attribute unrelated host contention to this code. Publish net SLOC/AST, clone excess, exports, binaries and measured gate/acquisition changes through existing structured evidence owners. Bind a deterministic assertion of the chosen reduction and counterexamples before closure. Preserve unresolved process-exit finding evidence:sha256:d48c972c45ee19bd89d2f96db2437198c5688e4db2fe02759c7ede8ffe3f5da2 until explained; successful later runs do not prove it fixed. Propose the next high-value local slice from remaining measured costs; do not restore foreign rows or equate no current assignment with no useful work. Correct packageCacheAudit's pending-as-executed label using retained execution records before interpreting counts; distinguish observed, failed, unstarted and deferred packages without a second mutable execution counter. The a7a81b14 publication passed in 12m25s with 4m25s acceptance and 4m0s owner tests, and its four deferred lanes passed in 344.1s. The identical nine-census test subset improved from 92.688s to 17.612s; do not present that subset result as whole-gate acceleration.
